_about: Reference TypeScript shapes for the vibe matching/path DTOs, extracted from upstream kima-hub `frontend/lib/api.ts` (interfaces `VibeTrack`, `VibePathTrack` and the inline response types of getVibeSimilar/getVibeAlchemy/getVibePath). Replaces reading the bundled `frontend/` copy, which was removed (owner decision 2026-11-18, D-180). `trackNo` is excluded: /vibe/similar and /vibe/alchemy never send it. Re-verify against an external checkout with `KIMA_HUB_REFERENCE=<kima-hub checkout> cargo test -p kima-api-types --test vibe -- --ignored`.
fields: totalTracks: number; embeddingDistance: number; averageStepSize: number; mode: string
